task: Reproduce central empirical conclusions from NOAA cloud-seeding records (US, 2000-2025)

method_contract.spatial_concentration: Record counts by state, percentage shares, HHI, effective number of states
method_contract.annual_dynamics: Year-by-year record counts, period means, state-disaggregated trends
method_contract.purpose_composition: Normalized purpose categories, frequency distributions, purpose-by-season cross-tabs
method_contract.agent_apparatus: Simplified agent categories, apparatus type cross-tabulation, temporal evolution

target_artifacts.fig1a_choropleth: Choropleth map of records by state
target_artifacts.fig2_annual_trend: Line plot of annual record counts
target_artifacts.fig2b_annual_by_state: Stacked area of top 5 states over time
target_artifacts.fig3b_purpose_by_season: Stacked bar of purpose by season
target_artifacts.fig4b_apparatus_by_year: Stacked bar of apparatus by year
target_artifacts.fig4c_agent_over_time: Line plot of top agents over time
target_artifacts.fig7_state_year_heatmap: Heatmap of state x year for top states
